name: Agilitas
description: Agilitas Sports Pvt Ltd (CIN U32300MH2023PTC448205, incorporated Feb 23, 2023, Mumbai) is the Reebok India licensee, also holding a Lotto license and owning Mochiko Shoes and One8. Directors include Abhishek Ganguly (ex-Puma India MD), Harsha Raghavan and Virender Awal.

marketing_spend.derivation: Files with MCA but no advertising line surfaced — the business is still B2B-manufacturing-heavy (Mochiko), and the consumer-facing debut (Reebok/Lotto/One8) is recent. Not in PMAR's top-10. Most of the ₹1,015 crore revenue is B2B; triangulating on the consumer launch's campaign presence at ~8-12% of a small consumer-revenue base gives a rough ₹40-90 crore for FY25 — the lowest-confidence estimate.

business_updates.headline: ₹225 crore raise led by Nexus Venture Partners and Rainmatter; Anushka Sharma participating
Acquired One8 Select, the Virat Kohli brand
FY25 revenue grew 39% to ₹1,015 crore but slipped to an ₹86 crore loss on expansion
